dedupe_keys.name: industrial corrosion failure analysis cases in china 1979 to 1998

description: This dataset collects case analyses of corrosion failures of industrial equipment and structures, published as the data behind a China Scientific Data paper on industrial corrosion failure analysis cases from 1979 to 1998. The Science Data Bank page gives six authors, the subject materials science, the keyword failure analysis case, two files totalling about 5.6 MB and version 1 published on 26 October 2015, curated by China Scientific Data and included in the National Basic Science Data Center. The DataCite record gives the CC BY 4.0 licence and Chinese as the language; files are free to download. Coverage is industrial failure cases in China over two decades. Caveats: the page description is minimal, so the number of cases, the fields recorded and the file formats are not stated on the page read, and the cases are historical. For simulation it gives failure modes and causes of corroded industrial assets to inform deterioration and failure probability assumptions in ageing models of plants. Related catalogue records include the material degradation events in the process industry database and the ARIA accident database.
